gen-gf-revalia-gf-roboto: A loose, boldly drawn stride of tall display letters up front. Roboto, a tidy sans with generous round mouths, gives the widely spaced stride of Revalia something steady to lean on.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-ruda: Revalia stands tall and wide up top, its g curling open below and its letters loosely spaced. Ruda, a sans-serif with a sizable x-height, reads smoothly down the screen.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Whimsical, stubby, towering lowercase, diagonals as hefty as the stems themselves. Noto Sans Vithkuqi, a modern sans, keeps its a, c, e and s all open in the throat.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sintony: Tall lowercase nearly touching the capitals, Gugi cuts its terminals open so the counters flow outward. Sintony is a sans with a chunky, tall midzone and no clogged curves.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-stack-sa: Love Ya Like A Sister is loose and bold, its terminal tips pointing outward and its ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Stack Sans Headline supplies a monoline sans with crisp, wide gaps underneath.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-archivo: Archivo, a sans-serif with a commanding x-height and curves that open outward, sits beside the wide, fixed-nib mouths of Shantell Sans. Its reading feel stays editorial yet approachable, paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-asap: Shantell Sans has a mouth wide as a cut tin lid and diagonals that match its uprights in weight. Asap, a sans-serif, does the quieter work, its lowercase nearly capital height.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-ranade: A mouth wide as a cut tin lid marks Shantell Sans, drawn with one fixed nib. Ranade, a sans with gently thickening shoulders and spread-out letters, loosens the page around it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-supreme: Expressive and distinctive, Shantell Sans cuts a mouth wide as a tin lid with a quiet, level beat. Supreme, a plain sans with crisp, heavy-looking middles, holds it steady.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-orbit: Shantell Sans is the one that talks, wide-mouthed and expressive. Orbit, a plain sans, does the listening, its rope-like stems and floating, open-ended curves staying out of the way.
